lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: CAPPING & PINNING CEREMONY! Hawak mo ang maliit na ilawang lampara sa puting clinical uniform mo — opisyal ka nang sasabak sa hospital RLE duty!
lines.textEn: CAPPING & PINNING CEREMONY! Holding the Nightingale lamp in your crisp white clinical uniform — you are officially cleared for hospital RLE duty!

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Ang linis tingnan ng puting uniform mo, anak! Ingat lagi sa night shift duty sa ospital ha.
lines.textEn: You look radiant in that white uniform, anak! Stay safe on every hospital night shift.

choices.text: Bumili ng matibay na stethoscope at clinical kit (-₱380, ++GWA, +Mental).
choices.textEn: Invest in a reliable stethoscope and clinical kit (-₱380, ++GWA, +Mental).

lines.speaker: Clinical Instructor
lines.text: Return Demonstration at 12-hour Ward Duty! Huwag kakabahan sa vital signs at charting — buhay ng pasyente ang nakasalalay!
lines.textEn: Return Demonstration and 12-hour Ward Duty! Keep steady hands on vital signs and charting — patient lives depend on accuracy!

choices.text: Tapusin ang ward duty nang may malasakit at focus (-Energy, ++GWA).
choices.textEn: Complete the ward shift with empathy and precision (-Energy, ++GWA).
